blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Center Kristaps Porzingis will be out indefinitely for the Golden State Warriors with a health issue, and general manager Mike Dunleavy offered no further details but wasn’t ready to call this a long-term concern. Dunleavy was informed about Porzingis’ status on Sunday. The big man had already been working out at Chase Center recently. “He was in last week, doing well and everything. I don’t have a timeline on it,” Dunleavy said at media day Monday. “Hopefully he will be back soon.” READ: NBA: Porzingis re-signing with Warriors on 2-year, $40M deal Porzingis wasn’t set to travel with […]...
